newsitem.title: UK: Man charged over 1994 IRA attack on Heathrow.
newsitem.headline: Man charged over 1994 IRA attack on Heathrow.

text.p: British police said on Saturday they had charged a 50-year-old man in connection with a 1994 IRA mortar attack on London's Heathrow airport.
Michael Gallagher will appear at a magistrates court on Monday accused of conspiring to cause an explosion and two other guerrilla charges.
Five mortar bombs were fired over the airport's perimeter fence in March 1994. No-one was injured but the airport closed and flights were delayed or diverted.
Gallagher is also accused of admitting to being a member of the Irish Republican Army, which seeks to end British rule in Northern Ireland, and of providing a car and garage to help the guerrillas.
Gallagher was arrested on Monday after a police raid in London. A second man was released without charge after questioning.
